translations.web: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”
translations.bsb: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me. But this has happened that the Scriptures would be fulfilled.”
translations.kjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
translations.asv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but this is done that the scriptures might be fulfilled.
